'''Dakarai Blirr''', the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] brother of [[Sadiki Blirr]], was the operations [[Officer/Legends|officer]] and designer of the [[Cog Hive Seven]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]]. He masqueraded as the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] male '''Zero''' while secretly serving the arms dealer [[Iram Radique]], who surreptitiously operated out of the prison. Blirr used his alter ego Zero to interact with the inmates while smuggling in parts for Radique. He was later killed by an inmate named [[Coyle]] after Radique discovered his true identity.
